handler.zh-CN: 返回触发拖动的元素，返回 null 时回退为被拖动元素本身。
handler.en-US: Returns the element that starts a drag. Falls back to the dragged element itself when it returns null.

constrainer.zh-CN: 限制拖动范围的元素：'parent' 或返回该元素的函数，该元素需要为 relative 定位。
constrainer.en-US: Element that bounds the movement: 'parent' or a function returning it. The element needs relative positioning.

allowInputDrag.zh-CN: 在原生 input、textarea 上按下时是否允许拖动。
allowInputDrag.en-US: Whether pressing on a native input or textarea starts a drag.

allowMove.zh-CN: 按下时判断是否允许拖动的函数，返回 false 则不拖动。
allowMove.en-US: Called when a pointer goes down. Return false to not drag.

customMove.zh-CN: 自定义拖动后的位置处理；设置后组件只回传计算出的位置，不再改写元素的 top 与 left。
customMove.en-US: Takes the new position instead of the element's top and left; the component only reports the computed position.

positionStrategy.zh-CN: 定位策略，relative 保留元素原有的布局位置。
positionStrategy.en-US: Positioning strategy. relative keeps the element's place in the layout.

mouseDown.zh-CN: 鼠标或触控笔按下时触发。
mouseDown.en-US: Emitted when a mouse or pen pointer is pressed.

mouseMove.zh-CN: 鼠标或触控笔移动时触发。
mouseMove.en-US: Emitted when a mouse or pen pointer moves.

mouseUp.zh-CN: 鼠标或触控笔抬起时触发。
mouseUp.en-US: Emitted when a mouse or pen pointer is released.

touchStart.en-US: Emitted when a touch pointer is pressed.

touchMove.en-US: Emitted when a touch pointer moves.

touchEnd.en-US: Emitted when a touch pointer is released.

touchCancel.en-US: Emitted when a touch pointer is cancelled.

default.zh-CN: 被拖动的内容，其中每个顶层元素或单根组件各自可拖动。
default.en-US: Content to drag. Each top-level element, or single-root component, is dragged on its own.
